page.notes: The Hebrew forms are at the limit of legibility on this scan; the vowel points and several root letters are uncertain, so Hebrew words are given without a [?] marker only where the letters are clear. Several Latin words in the right column are blurred (for example "ageт", which is a typesetting or scan fault; the Latin reads "agit" and the Greek-like glyph is probably a misprint or damage). The "V" beneath the left column and the faint marks at the foot are not printed text and are omitted.
